mapper.insert: insert into review_git_credential (credential_name, provider, auth_type, token_ciphertext, status, last_check_status, remark, create_by, create_time) values (#{credentialName}, #{provider}, #{authType}, #{tokenCiphertext}, #{status}, 'UNTESTED', #{remark}, #{createBy}, sysdate())
mapper.update: update review_git_credential set last_check_status = #{lastCheckStatus}, last_check_message = #{lastCheckMessage}, last_check_time = #{lastCheckTime}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where credential_id = #{credentialId}
